items.title: NVO's Hemophilia A Treatment Gets EC Nod, Data Presented on CagriSema
items.summary: Novo Nordisk received European Commission approval for Frehemgo (denecimig), a next-generation bispecific antibody for hemophilia A prophylaxis. The company also presented positive Phase III data for CagriSema, showing 20.7-21.0% weight loss at 68 weeks versus 2.0% for placebo, with FDA decision expected in Q4 2026. However, Novo faces intensifying competition from Eli Lilly's obesity and diabetes drugs.

items.title: NVO Q3 Earnings Call Highlights GLP-1 Growth and Raised Outlook
items.summary: Novo Nordisk raised its 2026 sales and profit outlook after beating Q3 earnings and revenue estimates, driven by strong obesity treatment demand and accelerating Wegovy pill adoption. The company targets a 2027 CagriSema launch but faces headwinds from U.S. pricing pressure, Ozempic price erosion, and Medicare-dependent growth.
